import json, os
items = json.loads(os.environ.get("FLOW_ITEMS", "[]"))
path = "/home/imae/flowforge/data/sandbox/device-health.md"
lines = ["# Device health report", ""]
for it in items:
    j = it["json"]
    lines += [
        f"- run: {j.get('runId')}",
        f"- at: {j.get('at')}",
        f"- disk /: {j.get('disk_root_used_gb')} / {j.get('disk_root_total_gb')} GB ({j.get('disk_root_pct')}%)",
        f"- disk /home/imae: {j.get('disk_home_pct')}%",
        f"- load (1m): {j.get('load1')}",
        f"- memory: {j.get('mem_avail_mb')} / {j.get('mem_total_mb')} MB available",
        f"- downloads folder: {j.get('downloads_count')} entries",
        f"- grade: {j.get('grade')} — {j.get('message')}",
        f"- note: {j.get('note', '-')}",
        "",
    ]
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))
print(json.dumps([{"json": {**items[0]["json"], "report_path": path}}] if items else [{"json": {"report_path": path}}]))
